feature_authority: Deployed original initializer only. Native ID is a category, not a physical anatomy or current visibility label. Original stored dynamic order is not re-permuted.

authority_rules.D_DIRECT: Needs source evidence about the intended native/part on the intended instance. A visible wood patch, crop-centre owner, local witness or nominal ref in crop alone is not native D.
authority_rules.E_EXTERNAL: Needs intended instance/part correspondence plus positive foreign foreground obstruction evidence. Wrong instance, query OFF, no depth/mask, padding, physical no-material or unsupported correspondence do not imply E.
authority_rules.S_SELF: Keep distinct upstream geometric/source self visibility authority; absence at q or a rear slot name does not establish S.
authority_rules.LOCATION_UNSUPPORTED: Separate query/part-association axis; never converted to E or coordinate correction.
authority_rules.UNKNOWN: Retain unsupported correspondence/missing evidence and original U; valid geometry alone cannot promote native visibility.
authority_rules.weak_part_auxiliary: Bounded same-part weak witnesses/intervention targets may be useful without a perfect mesh/corner certificate, but remain explicitly separate auxiliary authority, not automatically native D/E.

coverage_aware_validation.group_unit: original component; all8/sibling variants inherit role
coverage_aware_validation.never: Treat candidate GT duplicates or paired variants as independent examples. Infer missing evidence means negative E. Optimize on protected scores. Claim prior-exposed small internal DEV is freshblind or OOD.

architecture_comparison.logic: Can express per-slot prior; cannot by itself express image×native interaction.
